request.style: English, Christian hip hop, a female rapper with a warm confident delivery, a soulful sung hook, boom bap drums, sampled gospel choir chops, jazzy bass, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If God is for us, tell me who can be against us
He didn't spare his Son, gave him up for all of us
Who brings a charge, who condemns, who's the judge
Christ died and rose, now he's interceding with love
Trouble or hardship, persecution or hunger
Nakedness, danger, the sword pulling under
In all these things we are more than conquerors
Through him who loved us, yeah, that's the anchor

[Chorus]
Nothing can separate us from the love of God
Not death, not life, not angels, not powers
Not height, not depth, nothing in all creation
Nothing can separate us from his love

[Verse]
I'm convinced in my bones and I'm sure in my soul
Not things in the present or the future unknown
Not the night that I cried or the day that I fell
Not the voice in my head saying I couldn't be held
I'm a child of the King, I'm called by his name
His love doesn't flicker, his love doesn't change
So I walk in the storm and I stand in the fire
Held by a love that is deeper and higher

[Chorus]
Nothing can separate us from the love of God
Not death, not life, not angels, not powers
Not height, not depth, nothing in all creation
Nothing can separate us from his love
